question: Who won the Women's Singles Australian Open 2020 Tennis title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sofia Kenin.**__ ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sofia Kenin** defeated Garbiñe Muguruza in the final, 4–6, 6–2, 6–2 to win the women's singles tennis title at the 2020 Australian Open.
 
• It was her first major title.
 
• Sofia Anna is an **American professional tennis player. **** **
 
• Kenin **picked up a foot injury**, pulled out of the Olympics, and later the US Open due to testing positive for COVID-19, prior to finally stop work her** season having not played since Wimbledon.**
